newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close weaker with other markets.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close weaker with other markets.

text.p: Italian stocks closed lower on Wednesday in line with losses on other stock markets, particularly Germany's, and weighed by a weaker lira and easier Btp bond futures amid continuing worries over the start of EMU and domestic politics, traders said.
There was active arbitrage trading on Fib bourse index futures with March falling below support at 17,580.
Telecoms were weak but financial holding Gemina firm.
The All-share Mibtel index ended down 1.5 pct at 11,899 but off an 11,856 low. The Mib30 blue chip index closed off 1.63 pct at 17,600 after a session low at 17,517.
Traders said the market was still awaiting details on the share swap ratio for telecoms holding Stet's merger with Telecom Italia which should be announced at Friday board meetings.
Stet ended 2.34 percent off at 7,603 lire, Telecom down 3.09 percent at 4,172 and mobile phone operator TIM down 3.14 percent at 4,258.
Industrial holding HPI was down 3.91 percent at 1,082 but there was arbitrage with Gemina which put on 3.29 percent to 498.9. Textiles group Marzotto ended off 2.74 percent at 14,365.
Energy group ENI was off 2.16 percent at 8,472, Fiat slipped 0.81 percent to 5,495 and Olivetti lost 1.65 percent to 619.5.
Paper group Burgo ended up 2.92 percent to 8,379 on broker buy advice and Autogrill closed up 3.41 percent to 2,399 on good 1996 profit figures.
